subject: Data retention and logging controls - post-call recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention and logging controls - post-call recap

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sanjay — really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Scope: FinTechCo needs strict controls for PII and transaction data for the payments product. Primary asks were: zero (0) retention on raw inputs and prompts, EU data residency, and tightened access to operational logs.
- Options we discussed: Hosted API with custom retention windows vs Dedicated/Private deployment enabling stronger isolation and contractable retention guarantees.
- Action items we committed to: 
  1) Share a short summary of our retention options (see attached "data_retention_policy_summary.pdf").
  2) Neha (security) to confirm what we can commit to in contract language for 0-retention and what operational/monitoring trade-offs exist.
  3) Marissa to propose a next call with Legal + Security to review redlines.

We attached a one-pager that outlines the three retention profiles (Default: 30 days logs, Short: 0-30 day configurable, Zero: 0 retention for user content with exceptions for operational traces). Please see the PDF and let me know which profile you'd like us to draft into the MSA as an appendix.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-min follow-up next week (Mon/Tue) with Priya (security) and our security lead Neha? I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: data_retention_policy_summary.pdf

From: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Data retention and logging controls - post-call recap

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. A few clarifying points from our side: 

1) Zero retention requirement: we need confirmation that for any PII-containing inputs (names, account numbers, card tokens) Redwood will not persist the raw content beyond the transaction processing window. Ideally we want a contractual 0-retention guarantee for user inputs processed by the model when running in our EU region.
2) Logs & monitoring: we understand you need some operational telemetry for throttling/health, but want those logs to be either aggregated with no PII or retained for a maximum of 7 days.
3) Residency: all data processing and storage must occur in the EU.

If you can confirm the above and send a proposed contract snippet we can run it through our legal/security. Also please attach your SOC 2 summary for initial review.

Thanks,
Sanjay Gupta
Director, Product Security | FinTechCo
Sanjay.Gupta@fintechco.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Data retention and logging controls - post-call recap

Hi Sanjay — appreciate the clear asks. High-level confirmation and constraints below: 

- 0-retention for user inputs: We can offer a contractual commitment to not persist raw input/output data (user prompts/responses) for customers using Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments. For our Hosted API, we offer configurable retention profiles; the strictest profile is "Zero-content retention" for customer content, but note that we may keep ephemeral operational traces (request ids, timestamps) for a short window to support debugging.

- Operational/aggregated logs: We can provide aggregated telemetry without PII and cap retention to 7 days per your request. We will add a clause that operational traces will be redacted/hashed and used only for platform health.

- Data residency: We can ensure all processing and storage in EU regions when the account is configured for EU-only. For Hosted API, this requires selecting the EU region during onboarding (we'll provide the region endpoints). For Dedicated/Private, we can deploy into your cloud or VPC in the EU.

- Embeddings & cached KV: Important note — if you use embeddings or enable KV caching of user content for performance, that content is persisted; we can either disable caching or set a retention TTL (e.g., 0 seconds). Please confirm whether embeddings are required for your workloads.

- Contract language: I will draft proposed MSA appendix language that (1) commits to zero retention of user content for Dedicated/Private, (2) allows Hosted accounts a configurable retention profile with a maximum 7-day retention for operational telemetry, and (3) states EU-only processing. There are operational trade-offs: a true 0-retention posture reduces our ability to debug rare model faults; we propose a mechanism for on-demand diagnostic logs with explicit customer authorization.

I'll send a draft redline by EOD Monday.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@fintechco.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Data retention and logging controls - post-call recap

Thanks all — next steps below: 

- Neha will send the draft MSA appendix and redlines (including the 0-retention wording and the on-demand diagnostics flow) by EOD Monday (she's targeting Mar 16).
- I'll pull together a short mutual action plan and sample clause for your legal team and attach the redlines (will include the SOC2 summary and the retention one-pager).
- Proposed pilot: run a 4-week pilot on a Dedicated instance in EU with caching disabled and 0-ttl for embeddings. This will give FinTechCo the contractual guarantees you need while we validate performance. Will Rishi follow up on pricing/commitment details separately.

Can we pencil in Tue 17 Mar 09:00 CET for a 30-min legal + security sync? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to getting this into contract.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0198
